dragonknight.name: Dragonknight
dragonknight.passive: Greatsword: tap to swing, hold to raise the blade for an overhead slam and release to strike (x3.5 when fully charged; it shakes the ground, staggers and stokes an extra Frenzy). Frenzy: melee hits grant +2 Power and +2% Attack Speed (max 10 stacks). After 3s without a hit, stacks fade one at a time.

rareArmor.name: Dragon Scale Plate
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | While a shield holds, you take 15% less damage and every hit gives +1 Frenzy

rareAmulet.name: Wyrmheart Pendant
rareAmulet.desc: +20% CDR | Every skill cast gives +2 Frenzy, and Frenzy stacks up to 15

rareBoots.name: Thunderstride Greaves
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Thunder Leap reaches 500px and its landing knocks enemies back

rareGloves.name: Berserker Gauntlets
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | At 10+ Frenzy, melee basics heal 1% Max HP per enemy hit (max 3% per swing)

upgA.name: Molten Aegis
upgA.desc: The shield is white-hot: it leaves a trail of dragonfire along its whole path, out and back. Enemies in the trail take 40% of the throw's damage every second (3 s).

upgB.name: Hunting Shield
upgB.desc: The shield bites into the first enemy it hits and stays lodged for 2.5 s, grinding it (half the throw's damage every 0.5 s). A full slam on that enemy rips it free: triple damage to it and a burst around it.

upgA.name: Inferno Edge
upgA.desc: While the blade burns, every full slam erupts in a ring of fire around you (150px) that deals this skill's damage and sets everything in it burning

upgB.name: Wyrmblood
upgB.desc: While the blade burns, every enemy your basics hit gives a small shield (up to 3 per swing), and every swing that connects heals 1% Max HP

upgA.name: Gravity Slam
upgA.desc: The landing pulls everything within 260 px into the impact point and staggers it (bosses are only tugged). Bundle a pack up for your Dragonfire and your breath.

upgB.name: Meteor Dive
upgB.desc: Hold Space to rise and hang in the air, untouchable, for up to 1.5 s, steering the landing with the cursor. Let go to dive: the longer you hung, the bigger the slam (up to x2.5 damage and 200 px). Dragon Breath in the air pours Wyrmfall down.

upgA.name: Glacial Breath
upgA.desc: Turns blue and heavily slows enemies

upgB.name: Sundering Breath
upgB.desc: The flames crack open whatever they touch: Sundered enemies take +20% damage from you for 6 s. Shields and Slime Warden orbs shatter.

spellweaver.name: Spellweaver
spellweaver.passive: Arcane Resonance: Each spell stores a charge (max 3). Each basic attack spends one: x1.8 damage, explodes in an AoE, and a hit cuts 0.25s off your Q, E and Space cooldowns.

rareArmor.name: Robes of the Magi
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | Mana Ward: while you hold Resonance, hits you take are 25% lower (a hit over 15 DMG spends a charge)

rareAmulet.name: Orb of Echoes
rareAmulet.desc: +20% CDR | Up to 4 Resonance charges, and charged bolts explode 50% wider

rareBoots.name: Blinkstep Slippers
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Every movement spell leaves an arcane echo where you were that bursts after 0.5s

rareGloves.name: Spellthread Gloves
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | Every 5th bolt is charged for free

upgA.name: Velocity
upgA.desc: +60% Projectile Speed; each Fireball stores 2 Resonance charges

upgB.name: Scorched Earth
upgB.desc: Leaves a burning surface for 0.75s

upgA.name: Deep Freeze
upgA.desc: Completely freezes enemies (0 Speed)

upgB.name: Ice Barrier
upgB.desc: Grants a slight personal shield

upgA.name: Arcane Arrival
upgA.desc: Shoots missile at nearest enemy

upgB.name: Frost Departure
upgB.desc: Leaves a small Frost Nova at start position

upgA.name: Accelerated Drop
upgA.desc: Reduces impact delay by 0.25s; the impact fills Resonance

upgB.name: Echo Blast
upgB.desc: Smaller secondary explosion after 1.5s

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.passive: Fleetfoot: Moving builds Momentum, up to +20 Power and +20% Move Speed in 2s. Standing still keeps it for 1s, then it fades over 2s.

rareWeapon.name: Stormcaller Bow
rareWeapon.desc: RMB: Chain Lightning, three lightning bolts that jump between enemies

rareArmor.name: Windrunner Tunic
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | At full Momentum, the next hit you take is dodged (once every 4s)

rareAmulet.name: Eye of the Storm
rareAmulet.desc: +20% CDR | A fully drawn Storm Arrow cuts 2s off Volley's cooldown

rareBoots.name: Trailblazer Boots
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Momentum builds twice as fast, and Vault fills it

rareGloves.name: Fletcher's Grips
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | Every 4th arrow splits into three

upgA.name: Ballista Shot
upgA.desc: A fully drawn arrow hurls everything on its line 220 px back. Whatever slams into a wall or a pillar on the way is stunned for 1.5 s. Bosses only stagger back.

upgB.name: Hunter's Mark
upgB.desc: The first enemy the arrow hits is Marked for 6 s: your basic arrows curve toward it and deal +40% to it.

upgA.name: Windwalk
upgA.desc: For 2 s you're wind: enemy shots pass through you.

upgB.name: Hunter's Focus
upgB.desc: For 4 s you plant your feet: Momentum stays full even standing still, and every basic looses two arrows.

upgA.name: Disengage
upgA.desc: You flip away from the cursor, and your next basic within 2 s looses a spread of 5 arrows.

upgB.name: Twin Vault
upgB.desc: Two charges, and every kill gives one back.

upgA.name: Storm Rain
upgA.desc: The volley becomes a storm cloud that rains arrows on its circle for 4 s (each arrow 45% of the hit, no falloff).

upgB.name: Focused Barrage
upgB.desc: Every arrow converges on the enemy nearest the cursor; the first 6 deal full damage.

nightblade.name: Nightblade
nightblade.passive: Expose Weakness: Periodically marks random nearby enemies. Hitting a marked enemy consumes the mark, dealing massive True Damage and granting a brief MS burst.

rareWeapon.name: Shadowstrike Daggers
rareWeapon.desc: RMB: Expose, every enemy in a cone in front of you gets a weak point facing you

rareArmor.name: Nightblade's Cowl
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | 100% Evade for 2s when dropping below 30% HP

rareAmulet.name: Sigil of the Hunt
rareAmulet.desc: +20% CDR | Expose Weakness marks 2-4 enemies instead of 1-3, and weak points deal +25% damage

rareBoots.name: Shadowstep Boots
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Phantom Dash leaves a puff of smoke where it started

rareGloves.name: Serrated Grips
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | Basic attacks make enemies bleed for their damage every second, for 3s

upgA.name: Blade Orbit
upgA.desc: The knives circle you for 3 s, cutting every enemy they pass from the side they move toward: they still pop weak points.

upgB.name: Venom Edge
upgB.desc: Knives stack Venom (up to 5, 6 s). A Phantom Dash through a venomed enemy bursts every stack as true damage.

upgA.name: Toxic Fumes
upgA.desc: Enemies in smoke take heavy continuous poison damage

upgB.name: Mirage
upgB.desc: Two shadows run out of the cloud and draw idle enemies (not bosses) for 3 s. Enemy shots that hit them break them.

upgA.name: Reaper's Chain
upgA.desc: A kill within 1 s of the dash's cut resets its cooldown.

upgB.name: Shadow Return
upgB.desc: Recast within 2 s to dash back to where you started, cutting the path again.

upgA.name: Bloodlust
upgA.desc: Each clone strike heals 2% Max HP, and popping a Weak Point yourself while the mark lasts heals 10%

upgB.name: Chain Reaction
upgB.desc: If the marked target dies, the mark and its remaining clone strikes jump to the nearest enemy, and marked enemies explode when they die

machinist.name: Machinist
machinist.passive: Salvage Economy: Enemies have a 25% chance to drop Scrap. Picking it up heals 5 HP and stores it (max 20). Hold Q to pour Scrap into a turret: a short hold spends 5 for a Heavy Turret (x1.5), a long hold 10 for a Siege Turret (x2, bigger, lasts longer). Big turrets are never replaced by new ones.

rareArmor.name: Hazard Suit
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | Immune to poison, slow effects and hits under 5 DMG

rareAmulet.name: Overclock Regulator
rareAmulet.desc: +20% CDR | Overclock lasts 2s longer, and turrets built during it are free Heavy Turrets

rareBoots.name: Mag-Lock Boots
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Grappling onto a turret or coil refreshes it and gives you a 40 shield

rareGloves.name: Salvager's Gauntlets
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | Every 25 pellets that hit give 1 Scrap

upgA.name: Flame Turret
upgA.desc: The turret sprays a 180 px cone of fire at enemies in reach, setting them burning.

upgB.name: Sniper Turret
upgB.desc: The turret reaches 900 px, picks the toughest enemy, and fires a piercing beam for x4 every 2 s.

upgA.name: High Voltage
upgA.desc: Roots enemies for 1s upon entering the field

upgB.name: Arc Network
upgB.desc: Draws lightning to nearby Sentry Turrets

upgA.name: Crash Landing
upgA.desc: Arriving knocks back and stuns enemies within 150 px for 0.6 s.

upgB.name: Decoy Projection
upgB.desc: Leaves a distracting hologram at the launch point

upgA.name: Exo-Frame
upgA.desc: For 8 s you wear a mech frame: the scattergun becomes a forward minigun stream, and you take 30% less damage.

upgB.name: Orbital Strike
upgB.desc: A satellite beam burns down toward the cursor for 3 s, following it as you move the mouse.

kensei.name: Kensei
kensei.passive: Flow & Stance: Toggle stances with E. Melee strikes build Flow, and Flow adds up to +150% damage to your slashes and the blade. Razor's Edge: every hit you take costs 25 Flow.

rareArmor.name: Ronin's Silk Shroud
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | Hits cost only 10 Flow instead of 25, and in Airborne you dodge 10% of hits.

rareGloves.name: Aether Grips
rareGloves.desc: +30% Attack Speed, the airborne blade included | Basic attacks generate 10% more Flow

upgA.name: Counter Stance
upgA.desc: Hold Q to guard for up to 1.5 s (slowed): every hit is parried and answered with an instant dash-slash at the attacker (x1.5). (Handheld)

upgB.name: Chain Surge
upgB.desc: The blade darts through up to 5 enemies in turn for x0.8 each, then returns to your steering. (Airborne)

upgA.name: Catch Parry
upgA.desc: Catching the recalled blade opens a 1 s parry window. (Handheld)

upgB.name: Twin Blades
upgB.desc: Deploying splits off a second, smaller blade (x0.6) that hunts enemies on its own while you steer the first. (Airborne)

upgA.name: Ghost Step
upgA.desc: For 1.5 s after the step enemies lose you, and your first hit deals +50%. (Handheld)

upgB.name: Echo Swap
upgB.desc: Within 2 s of a Spatial Swap you can swap back for free. (Airborne)

upgA.name: Vortex
upgA.desc: Whirlwind pulls enemies in aggressively. (Handheld)

upgB.name: Shard Shield
upgB.desc: The shards orbit you for 6 s, cutting what comes close and shattering enemy shots. (Airborne)

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.passive: Active Zeal Engine: Attacks generate Zeal. Spells consume Zeal. Divine Ray hits harder the more Zeal it spends (x1.75 at 50, x2.5 at 100); 0 Zeal casts have 50% DMG/AoE.

rareWeapon.name: Censer of the Twilight Horizon
rareWeapon.desc: RMB: Twilight Repulse, a repulsive aura that keeps enemies away (bosses only take the damage)

rareArmor.name: Vestments of the Fractured Soul
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | Adapts to Skill 1. Holy: take 15% less projectile DMG and fire a bolt back. Shadow: a free Desecration while below 25% HP (every 2s).

rareAmulet.name: Reliquary of Dawn and Dusk
rareAmulet.desc: +20% CDR | A spell cast at 100 Zeal keeps 25 Zeal

rareBoots.name: Pilgrim's Sandals
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Phase Shift leaves a small Hallowed Ground where you were

rareGloves.name: Thurible Chains
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | Censer pulses give 20 Zeal per enemy instead of 15

upgA.name: Radiant Flash (Holy)
upgA.desc: Instant blind. Each enemy newly blinded grants 10 Zeal.

upgB.name: Void Spike (Shadow)
upgB.desc: +40% DMG if <50% HP. Uses all Zeal for bigger cascade; with 0 Zeal it drains 5% HP instead and fires at full power (under Aspect of the Reaper: x1.75 power, no extra HP).

upgA.name: Sanctuary (Holy)
upgA.desc: Doubles regen, knocks back enemies, basic attacks grant double Zeal.

upgB.name: Desecration (Shadow)
upgB.desc: Strips defenses, deals shadow ticking DMG, 40% slow, shatters shields.

upgA.name: Divine Transposition (Holy)
upgA.desc: Swap places with nearest enemy & stun surrounding targets.

upgB.name: Raven Flight (Shadow)
upgB.desc: Costs 20 Zeal (10% HP without it). Every enemy you pass is hit, blinded and siphoned for 5% of your Max HP.

upgA.name: Avatar of Renewal (Holy)
upgA.desc: For 8s your Zeal stays full. Casting vents homing light bolts.

upgB.name: Aspect of the Reaper (Shadow)
upgB.desc: -50% CDs, no Zeal. Drains 4% Max HP per second. +50 Power. Kills heal 25% missing HP.

druid.name: Druid
druid.passive: Wild Bond: A wolf fights at your side. It hunts on its own, but goes after whatever you hit (Scent, 3s) and favours enemies your snares hold, biting rooted prey for +50% DMG. Every bite on Scented prey builds Bond; at 100 Bond its next bite is a Maul (x4 DMG, stuns). The wolf can't be hurt.

rareWeapon.name: Gnarled Heartwood Totem
rareWeapon.desc: RMB: Thistle-Grip Claws | Your wolf's Maul also hits every enemy within 100px for half its damage

rareArmor.name: Mantle of the Living Grove
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | Feral Surge's bark shell roots enemies that rush into it

rareBoots.name: Pathfinder Wraps
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Spirit Leap's landing fills 15 Bond

rareGloves.name: Packbond Bracers
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | Your seed bolts Scent for 6s, and each one that hits your companion's prey gives +3 Bond

upgA.name: Hunting Ground (Alpha)
upgA.desc: The snare leaves a thicket for 4s. Inside it the wolf bites 50% faster and its bites cleave.

upgB.name: Grasping Vines (Pack)
upgB.desc: The burst first drags every non-boss within reach to its centre, then roots them, packing them up for your AoE.

upgA.name: Bloodrage (Alpha)
upgA.desc: While surging, each of your wolf's bites heals you for 1.5% of Max HP.

upgB.name: Kindred Howl (Pack)
upgB.desc: A spirit wolf joins the hunt for 8s.

upgA.name: Alpha Leap (Alpha)
upgA.desc: Landing fills 25 Bond, and a Pounce Strike made at full Bond is a Maul.

upgB.name: Scatter the Herd (Pack)
upgB.desc: Landing knocks enemies back, and the wolf whirls where it stands, snapping at everything around it.

upgA.name: Dire Aspect (Alpha)
upgA.desc: Instead of spirit wolves, your wolf becomes a dire wolf for 8s: x2.5 bite damage, bites cleave, double Bond.

upgB.name: Wild Hunt (Pack)
upgB.desc: Four spirit wolves answer the call instead of two.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.passive: Celestial Anchor: Q throws your Grand Mace into the ground. Catch the returning hammer to cut Q to 1.2s: it homes in on you, then commits to a straight line for the last stretch. Your skills change depending on whether the hammer is Equipped or Deployed. While away from it you raise a light shield: -15% basic damage, +15% armor.

rareWeapon.name: The World-Breaker Grand Mace
rareWeapon.desc: Smash shockwaves leave fault lines for 2s. Throwing Judgment Hammer into a fault line drags every enemy on the fracture to the hammer.

rareArmor.name: Plate of the Gilded Bastion
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | While your hammer is deployed, gain 1% DMG reduction per 15 units of distance from it (max 25%)

rareAmulet.name: Seal of Judgment
rareAmulet.desc: +20% CDR | A clean hammer catch also resets Righteous Charge, and that charge hits +50%

rareBoots.name: Crusader Sabatons
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Righteous Charge and Iron Pull stun 0.5s longer

rareGloves.name: Gauntlets of Devotion
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | Smashes with the hammer in hand deal +30% damage and heal 1% Max HP per enemy hit (max 3%)

upgA.name: Handheld Purity
upgA.desc: Recalling the hammer triggers a seismic shockwave when it snaps back into your hand, stunning close enemies for 1.5s (once per 6s).

upgB.name: Conduit Shock
upgB.desc: While stuck in the ground, the hammer shoots holy lightning at the 2 nearest enemies within 200 range every 0.5s.

upgA.name: Overflowing Grace
upgA.desc: Healing from the chain past full HP becomes a shield (up to half your Max HP).

upgB.name: Chain of Retribution
upgB.desc: Enemy projectiles that cross the chain break on it and fly back at the attacker as homing holy bolts.

upgA.name: Bulldozer
upgA.desc: The charge carries everything it hits to its end and slams them together, stunned 1 s (2 s into a wall). (Equipped)

upgB.name: Gravitational Crashing
upgB.desc: Landing on your hammer via Iron Pull grounds and slows surrounding enemies by 50% for 3s. (Deployed)

upgA.name: Divine Aura
upgA.desc: The consecrated ground follows you as a moving aura instead of staying in place.

upgB.name: Hammer of the Gods
upgB.desc: Cast while the hammer is deployed: it grows colossal and spins into an iron hurricane that pulls enemies toward it.

monk.name: Monk
monk.passive: Flurry of Blows: every skill cast or recast, the right-click included, stores a charge (2 at most). Your next basic spends one and becomes 4 quick blows, and each blow that lands builds Chi. At 100 Chi the next flurry is a Hundred-Hand Strike: 8 blows and a shockwave. Every skill can be recast within a short window.

rareWeapon.name: Dragon Fang Wraps
rareWeapon.desc: RMB: Iron Body | For 1.5 s you take 50% less damage and roots and traps can't hold you; it ends in a chi pulse that hurts and pushes back enemies within 140px

rareArmor.name: Robes of the Still Mountain
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | Iron Will's lifesteal past full health becomes a shield

rareBoots.name: Cloudstep Sandals
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Swift Step goes 30% farther and its recast window lasts 4.5 s

rareGloves.name: Tiger Claw Wraps
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | A flurry throws 2 more blows

upgA.name: Seven-Star Rush
upgA.desc: A Rushing Fist that kills marks the nearest enemy within 350 px and reopens the window, up to 6 rushes a cast. Weaken the pack, then zig-zag through it.

upgB.name: Resonating Mark
upgB.desc: While the mark lasts it stores 30% of all the damage you deal its enemy. Rushing Fist detonates the store on top of its strike: the burst for bosses and elites.

upgA.name: Gathering Palm
upgA.desc: The recast pulls every marked enemy within 500 px into a heap in front of you and staggers it for 0.5 s (bosses are only tugged). Set up the Hundred-Hand Strike and Crane Kick.

upgB.name: Stone Skin
upgB.desc: Every enemy the palm marks gives a shield of 5% Max HP (up to 5) for 6 s. The recast hardens it: while it holds, roots, traps and knockbacks can't move you, and when it breaks it bursts outward.

upgA.name: Tiger's Path
upgA.desc: Swift Step strikes everything it passes (a basic and a half each, 6 Chi each); 3 or more struck give an extra flurry charge. Iron Will stays.

upgB.name: Karmic Will
upgB.desc: Iron Will keeps its lifesteal, and for its 4 s you take 25% less and everything you take is stored. When it ends, a shockwave round you deals the store x2 (160 px).

upgA.name: Pinball Kick
upgA.desc: The kicked body bounces off rock, boulders, the map's edge and enemies up to 3 times, bowling and stunning on every leg. Dragon's Descent still follows it.

upgB.name: Rising Dragon
upgB.desc: The kick launches the enemy straight up for 1.5 s, out of the fight (not bosses). The recast leaps up after it: 6 blows in the air, then you spike it down for a 140 px shockwave. On a boss, the same combo on the ground.

witch.name: Witch
witch.passive: Contagion: your basic is a poison spray that hits every enemy in a short cone and stacks poison (5 stacks at most). When a poisoned enemy dies, its stacks jump to the nearest enemies. Killed enemies may leave a soul behind (Hexed ones always do, bosses shed them as they bleed); Raise Dead turns the souls near you into zombies that fight for you and draw enemies to them.

rareWeapon.name: Gravewood Staff
rareWeapon.desc: RMB: Dark Pact | Sacrifice the zombie nearest the cursor: it bursts in poison (140px, 3 basics and 2 poison stacks), and you heal for the HP it had left

rareArmor.name: Shroud of the Coven
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | You take 4% less damage for each living zombie (20% at most)

rareBoots.name: Midnight Broom
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Broom Flight lasts 0.7 s longer

rareGloves.name: Blightweaver Gloves
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | Poison stacks up to 8 instead of 5

upgA.name: Grave Pull
upgA.desc: Hands out of the ground drag everything in the circle to its centre (bosses are only tugged): heap the pack up for the spray and the toads.

upgB.name: Soul Leech
upgB.desc: Your poison on hexed enemies heals you for 15% of its damage (at most 3% Max HP a second): hex the pack, stand in it and spray.

upgA.name: Grave Knights
upgA.desc: The dead rise armed: knights with rusted swords and shields, 50% more HP, swings x1.8, and they draw enemies from 260 px (was 180). Your front line.

upgB.name: Skeleton Archers
upgB.desc: The dead rise as skeletons with bows: they keep their places round you and shoot the nearest enemy within 450 px (x1.6 a shot), but don't draw enemies and have 30% less HP. Damage from behind you.

upgA.name: Swoop
upgA.desc: Space again dives you at the cursor (250 px at most): you crash down for the Swoop's hit and 2 poison stacks round you (130 px), knocking enemies back.

upgB.name: Soul Sweep
upgB.desc: The broom gathers the souls it flies over, and when you land they rise round you at once: a free Raise Dead, from souls anywhere on the field.

upgA.name: Toad Plague
upgA.desc: When the hex ends, or a toad dies, it bursts in a poison cloud: half the hex's hit and 2 poison stacks to everything within 90 px.

upgB.name: Familiar Toads
upgB.desc: The toads are yours: they hop at the nearest of their old allies and bite them (15% of the hex's hit every 0.8 s).

swordsaint.name: Swordsaint
swordsaint.passive: Style: every action that lands a hit raises your Style rank (D, C, B, A, S), much more when it differs from the last one, so weave cuts and skills. Dodge an enemy hit with Gale Step or Mana Burst for a Perfect dodge: a full rank and a second of bullet time. Each rank adds Power and a little attack speed, up to +60 Power and +20% at S; a hit taken drops two ranks. Every skill cancels the sword's recovery.

rareWeapon.name: Caliburn
rareWeapon.desc: RMB: Hammer of the Wind King | Fire a tornado of compressed wind 450px forward; it carries enemies along its path (not bosses) and hits each for 2 basics over its flight

rareArmor.name: Mail of Avalon
rareArmor.desc: +240 Max HP | Once every 30 s, a blow that would kill you is a Perfect dodge instead

rareAmulet.name: Seal of the Round
rareAmulet.desc: +20% CDR | A hit taken drops your Style one rank, not two

rareBoots.name: Prana Greaves
rareBoots.desc: +50 Move Speed | Mana Burst holds 3 charges

rareGloves.name: Lionheart Gauntlets
rareGloves.desc: +25% Attack Speed | The third cut's thrust also sends a wave of sword-light 250px ahead

upgA.name: Tempest Dance
upgA.desc: Each spin draws the enemies within 160 px in to you, and the slam throws the heap into the air for 0.6 s, helpless (not bosses). The Q gathers the pack.

upgB.name: Duelist's Lunge
upgB.desc: Each step locks onto the enemy nearest the cursor and lunges through it. Two lunges through the same enemy make the third step a plunge onto it for x3. The Q duels one.

upgA.name: Wind Cannon
upgA.desc: Strike Air becomes a 450 px blast forward that hurls enemies 150 px back; one slammed into rock or another body is stunned for 1.2 s. Control at range.

upgB.name: Eye of the Storm
upgB.desc: The burst hauls every enemy within 240 px in to you, then stuns them (bosses only take the hit). It gathers the pack for the spins and Crosscut.

upgA.name: Counter Burst
upgA.desc: A perfect dodge with Mana Burst marks the attacker; when the burst lands you flash back through them for a counter of 3 basics. The dodge answers itself.

upgB.name: Overdrive
upgB.desc: Mana Burst cuts everything it passes through for a basic each, and every enemy cut gives 15 Style (3 at most). The dash is an attack.

upgA.name: Endless Seal
upgA.desc: Each perfect dodge while Unsealed adds 2 s to it. Keep dodging and the seal never closes.

upgB.name: Twin Moons
upgB.desc: Excalibur can be fired twice, and charges in half the time: two quick beams, each x0.6 to x1.2, aimed two ways or crossed.
